narrative.overview: Three real product surfaces share one perspective stage below the protected blue opening. Native scrolling or fixed chapter controls selects resource discovery, community exchange, or blog spaces. Foreground text stays clear; mobile, short viewports and reduced motion expose all content in normal reading order.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral lit stage, white surfaces, black actions and fixed chapter navigation.
Separated perspective surfaces with an unblurred pixel-aligned foreground.
Actual resource controls, qualified public sharing and built-in template screenshots.
Native reading flow before enhancement and for reduced motion or constrained viewports.

rules.name: The Black Action Rule
rules.body: Within this boundary, primary actions and selected resource categories use Ink; blue belongs to the separately approved opening, not these action states.

rules.name: The Source Color Rule
rules.body: Colors inside actual catalog and template screenshots belong to the depicted source; they do not expand this presentation's token palette.

rules.name: The Heading Line Rule
rules.body: Preserve the authored heading line groups and tight tracking; supporting prose wraps naturally within its measured width.

rules.name: The Distinct Composition Rule
rules.body: Keep the resource shelf, community reading panel, and large template comparison visually distinct within this presentation; a repeated framed-browser treatment is not the established pattern.

rules.name: The Quiet Depth Rule
rules.body: Use tonal separation for ordinary content surfaces; preserve the existing template-specific shadow roles rather than adding shadows to every card.

dos: **Do** keep this system scoped to the product presentation below the approved opening.
**Do** pair black primary actions with quieter text actions and visible keyboard focus.
**Do** preserve source/license metadata, bounded-search wording, truthful empty states, and the fictional-template caption.
**Do** use actual catalog records and built-in template screenshots, with provenance beside shipping preview rasters.
**Do** retain working tabs, full-directory routes, native disclosures, and the mobile stacking behavior.
donts: **Don't** recolor the protected blue opening or shared navigation from this document.
**Don't** introduce blue primary actions into this neutral product presentation.
**Don't** turn screenshot colors, fonts, sample people, or internal template layouts into presentation-system primitives.
**Don't** invent public posts, customer claims, testimonials, user totals, engagement figures, or broader third-party reuse rights.
**Don't** replace the distinct section compositions with repeated framed browser windows or add shadows to every surface.
